scope: Owner-requested deeper read-only recheck of the two stable LibTV points entry controls in the existing authenticated personal session

interpretation.surfaceClass: points-commerce catalog rather than personal balance or ledger
interpretation.usageKeywordCaveat: A generic usage-related word appears in body copy, but there is no usage control, route, dashboard, quota meter, billing table or ledger view.
interpretation.routeFinding: Both stable entry controls open the same in-page modal and do not navigate to a dedicated account, billing, usage or ledger route.

conclusion: The deeper inspection resolves both stable points entries as aliases for one commerce-oriented modal. The visible authenticated surface offers points products and purchase/recharge controls, but no personal balance, quota, usage dashboard, bill, invoice, transaction history or ledger interface. No commerce control was activated, so this remains negative read-only evidence and does not accept B-01.
